title.narrative: Upgradation of Machine Tools Industry in India

description.narrative: Machine tool technology is the backbone of the engineering sector in the developing countries and has reached a critical phase of development. Nowadays, there is a special focus on the production of highly efficient and reliable machines to meet the growing needs of machine tool users. In India, the manufactures have to look at global markets to build volumes. This issue is of even greater relevance to a large number of enterprises in the sector as well as to tiny and small component manufacturing enterprises. Now, it is crucial for the machine tool industry to build up volumes, upgrade their products and processes technologically and quality wise for remaining competitive and provide substantive input to South-South technological partnership development and cooperation.
